notes.title: Changelog - July 10
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for participating in the first batch of the closed beta for Interdimensional Gas Station! We got hundreds of downloads in the first day and were flooded with feedback.



Keep in mind, playtest updates are not backwards compatible. Your previous saves are incompatible with the newer build. Thank you for your understanding



Changelog:

+ Fixed/added sounds and music

+ Linux build deployed

+ Increased line and word spacing for dialogue bubbles

+ Fixed dialogue typos

+ Adjusted Genetic Modifier manual pages for more clarity

+ Fixed incorrect Sarnth planet navigation information on manual page

+ Fixed issue where assassin could be sold out twice

+ Fixed issue where manual would skip first page

+ Added dynamic arrow visibility based on pages in current document

+ Removed confusing Baalistan quest line

+ Updated outdated font in playtest email request
